description: This file defines the AuditableInterceptor class which is a Hibernate interceptor for automatically setting auditing fields such as creator, dateCreated, changedBy, and dateChanged on OpenmrsObject instances during database persistence operations.

classes.name: AuditableInterceptor
classes.description: A Hibernate interceptor that automatically sets auditing fields such as creator, dateCreated, changedBy, and dateChanged on OpenmrsObject instances during save and update operations.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Called when a new object is being persisted; sets creator and dateCreated fields if they are null.

methods.name: onFlushDirty
methods.description: Called when an object is updated; sets changedBy and dateChanged fields, and possibly other audit information.

methods.name: onCollectionRecreate
methods.description: Handles collection recreation events during Hibernate flush; mainly used to update related audit info.

methods.name: setCreatorAndDateCreatedIfNull
methods.description: Sets creator and dateCreated fields for OpenmrsObject instances if null.

methods.name: changeProperties
methods.description: Helper method to update multiple properties on the entity's current state.

methods.name: getPropertyValuesToSave
methods.description: Returns a map of properties and their values to set when saving new objects.

methods.name: getPropertyValuesToUpdate
methods.description: Returns a map of properties and their values to set when updating objects.

methods.name: changePropertyValue
methods.description: Sets a specific property value in the entity's current state if applicable.

methods.name: handleCollectionChange
methods.description: Handles collection changes, particularly for user roles, updating audit info.
